payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance metrics for different discourse relations, indicating which relations the model performs best and worst on.

claims.text: The model achieves a 6-point F1-score improvement on Comparison relations and a 7-point improvement on Temporal relations, indicating better performance on these types.
The model's best macro-average F1-score for implicit discourse relations is 48.82%, suggesting it works best for implicit relations overall.
The CRF layer is noted to be unsuitable for binary classification, implying limitations in performance for certain discourse relations.
